L'After Foot est l'émission culte de RMC: L'After Foot is RMC Sport's cult post-match show. Lively debates, passionate pundits and tactical analysis come together in a live format that has become a benchmark of French sports broadcasting.
Le talk sportif de RMC animé par Daniel: RMC's sports talk show hosted by Daniel Riolo — the pioneer of French sports podcasting, a revolutionary of the debate format. Years of massive audiences, careers launched, a whole school of sports journalism. But over time, the clash has become a reflex: systematic contradiction ended up wearing thin. Our verdict: "A pioneering format turned media machine, with its strengths… and its excesses." — Alex. I was looking for less tension and more nuance, and I ended up tuning out. But the legacy is huge and undeniable.
